# Work <NNN> Coordination

This file is the work-local coordination entry point. The work folder is the source of truth.

## Current handoffs

- Current Owner: <agent/person/unassigned>
- Status: <Active / Blocked / Returned / Ready for Review>
- Active Task: <None / Link to tasks/task-XXX.md>

## Return protocol

The assigned agent updates the exact contract, `tasks.md`, `notes.md`, and this file before returning the task. `work/INDEX.md` links here and is updated if work status changes.
